name: Sydney Opera House
description: Perched on Bennelong Point, a spit of land jutting into Sydney Harbour, the Sydney Opera House is topped by sail-like white shells that have become Australia's best-known landmark. Danish architect Jørn Utzon won the 1957 design competition, and the building opened in 1973. Today its halls stage over 1,800 performances a year, and visitors can wander the broad terraces around it.
